title: Crystal structure of the HMGA AT-hook 1 domain bound to the minor groove of AT-rich DNA and inhibition by antikinetoplastid drugs.
authors: Nue-Martinez, J Jonathan; Maturana, Marta; Lagartera, Laura; Rodriguez-Gutierrez, Juan-Antonio; Boer, Roeland; Campos, J Lourdes; Saperas, Nuria; Dardonville, Christophe
one_liner_zh: 该研究解析了无序HMGA蛋白AT-hook 1结构域与AT-rich DNA小沟结合的晶体结构及热力学，并探讨药物竞争性抑制，虽涉及IDP-DNA互作机制，但对象为蛋白-DNA而非PPI，且方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟贡献有限。
abstract: High mobility group (HMG) proteins are intrinsically disordered nuclear non-histone chromosomal proteins that play an essential role in many biological processes by regulating the expression of numerous genes in eukaryote cells. HMGA proteins contain three DNA binding motifs, the "AT-hooks", that bind preferentially to AT-rich sequences in the minor groove of B-form DNA. Understanding the interactions of AT-hook domains with DNA is very relevant from a medical point of view because HMGA proteins are involved in different conditions including cancer and parasitic diseases. We present here the first crystal structure (1.40 A resolution) of the HMGA AT-hook 1 domain, bound to the minor groove of AT-rich DNA. In contrast to AT-hook 3 which bends DNA and shows a larger minor groove widening, AT-hook 1 binds neighbouring DNA molecules and displays moderate widening of DNA upon binding. The binding affinity and thermodynamics of binding were studied in solution with surface plasmon resonance (SPR)-biosensor and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments. AT-hook 1 forms an entropy-driven 2:1 complex with (TTAA)(2)-containing DNA with relatively slow kinetics of association/dissociation. We show that N-phenylbenzamide-derived antikinetoplastid compounds (1-3) bind strongly and specifically to the minor groove of AT-DNA and compete with AT-hook 1 for binding. The central core of the molecule is the basis for the observed sequence selectivity of these compounds. These findings provide clues regarding a possible mode of action of DNA minor groove binding compounds that are relevant to major neglected tropical diseases such as leishmaniasis and trypanosomiasis.
abstract_zh: 高迁移率族（HMG）蛋白是内在无序的核非组蛋白染色体蛋白，通过调控真核细胞中众多基因的表达，在许多生物过程中发挥关键作用。HMGA蛋白包含三个DNA结合基序，即“AT-hooks”，它们优先结合B型DNA小沟中的AT富集序列。从医学角度看，理解AT-hook结构域与DNA的相互作用非常重要，因为HMGA蛋白涉及包括癌症和寄生虫病在内的多种疾病。我们在此呈现了HMGA AT-hook 1结构域与AT富集DNA小沟结合的首个晶体结构（1.40 Å分辨率）。与使DNA弯曲并显示更大程度小沟加宽的AT-hook 3不同，AT-hook 1结合相邻DNA分子，并在结合时表现出适度的DNA小沟加宽。结合亲和力和结合热力学通过表面等离子体共振（SPR）-生物传感器和等温滴定量热法（ITC）实验在溶液中进行了研究。AT-hook 1与含(TTAA)₂的DNA形成熵驱动的2:1复合物，具有相对较慢的缔合/解离动力学。我们表明，N-苯基苯甲酰胺衍生的抗动质体化合物（1-3）强烈且特异性地结合AT-DNA的小沟，并与AT-hook 1竞争结合。该分子的核心部分是这些化合物观察到的序列选择性的基础。这些发现为DNA小沟结合化合物可能的的作用模式提供了线索，这些化合物与利什曼病和锥虫病等重大被忽视热带病相关。
